reviewNotes: Plan is tenant-neutral and does not duplicate Empresa identity.
Suscripcion requires positive EmpresaId and PlanId and documents that server-side tenant authority is enforced later in N6.9.D.
Plan.DefinirLimite upserts by normalized key and rejects non-positive quantitative limits.
Cancelled or expired subscriptions cannot change plan; suspend/reactivate transitions are explicit.
No migration, DbSet, repository, API, frontend, production, secret or deploy change is included in this DOMAIN parent.
Directed xUnit coverage exercises identity normalization, limit uniqueness, invalid identifiers/periods, lifecycle and vigencia semantics.
